title: Super excited to launch the first demo version of our AI powered RPG "Darkspell". U can try it now, appreciating feedback!
author: Gorgoroth117
selftext:
Darkspell is an AI powered RPG that lets u create worlds, fill them with characters objects, places through pure imagination. Images, and Speech is autmatically created for full immesion.

U can test the app on: [https://darkspell-frontend.vercel.app](https://darkspell-frontend.vercel.app)

The demo version is limited to 10 users with settoken budget for testing.

We know there are a LOT of things we need to improve on, any many features are yet to come. Still, we are super excited to release a first version because feedback helps a lot prioritizing the right things. Thank you for testing!

comments.author: Mental-Card84
comments.body: Looks cool, will have a look! How does it differ from Ai Dungeon?

comments.author: Ill-Hope-6701
comments.body:
Following, will let you know what I think.

What's unique?

replies.author: Mental-Card84
replies.body:
You can play as multiple characters and switch roles anytime. It’s not just storytelling — it’s dynamic world-building powered by your imagination and a supportive LLM.

We’d love your feedback! What do you like? What’s not working? What would you change? Every bit helps :)

replies.author: Mental-Card84
replies.body: Thanks for pointing that out! We just fixed the issue — you should be able to access it now. Let us know if you run into anything else 🙏

comments.author: gametorch
comments.body: Very cool. I can't wait til we have cheap local inference so you can use LLMs for dialogue and character creation for "free"
